trajectory_files.source: Jointly targeted, numerically integrated finite-SOI export variant
trajectory_files.note: Refined finite-radius patched-conic variant. Exported onboard delta-v 628.36 m/s, including 7.48 m/s of additional patch corrections; exported C3 29.03872 km2/s2. Intermediate flyby dates differ by up to 5.99558 days from the saved preview. Launch/final encounter dates are fixed; includes 0 months after the encounter. Preview metrics describe the original candidate. Download encounter and burn tables for this variant. Sun/planet two-body patches, not n-body or official mission ephemerides.
